name: How can I tell if my drain is clogged?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my drain is clogged?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a clogged drain include water draining slowly from sinks, tubs, or showers, gurgling sounds coming from drains or toilets, and unpleasant odors emanating from pipes. If water backs up into a sink or tub, or if your toilet overflows after flushing, these are clear indicators of a significant blockage. Multiple fixtures draining slowly could signal a main line issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slow drainage, gurgling sounds, foul odors, and water backing up are common signs of a clogged drain.
